data.name: Landing.MetaDescription
data.value: Wasla is a cloud-based online order management system for restaurant order management. It brings orders from food-ordering platforms onto one screen, with a kitchen order display and automatic receipt printing.

data.name: Landing.WhatIsWaslaLead
data.value: A cloud-based restaurant order management system that lets you manage orders from different food-ordering platforms on a single screen.

data.name: Landing.WhatIsWaslaProblem
data.value: Restaurants working with several ordering platforms usually have to follow multiple tablets, devices, and separate workflows at the same time.

data.name: Landing.WhatIsWaslaSolution
data.value: Wasla brings these order flows together and makes day-to-day operations easier to manage.

data.value: Restaurant staff review, confirm, and manage each order in the daily flow.

data.name: Landing.StepKitchenDescription

data.name: Landing.ProblemKitchenCoordinationDescription
data.value: Kitchen and order management move forward more clearly in the same flow.

data.name: Landing.ProblemAutoPrintDescription
data.value: Receipts are sent to the printer automatically through Wasla Print Bridge.

data.name: Landing.ProblemBusyHoursDescription

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep1Title
data.value: Step 1 — Download the Print Bridge package

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep1Text
data.value: Print Bridge is currently provided as a portable Windows package (.zip). Download the package, extract it on the Windows computer connected to the receipt printer, and run Wasla.PrintBridge.exe. Open Settings, paste the device token, select your printer, turn off Test mode for real printing, and save settings to connect.

data.name: PrintBridge.PackageNotPrepared
data.value: The installation package is not ready yet.

data.name: PrintBridge.PackageNotPreparedHint
data.value: The portable package will be available here after deployment packaging is complete.

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep2Text
data.value: Go to Wasla Print Bridge > Devices. Enter a device name such as "Kitchen PC", "Cashier PC", or "Vivo", create a token, and copy the generated token.

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep3Title
data.value: Step 3 — Open the Settings tab in the Print Bridge app

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep3Text
data.value: Open the Windows Print Bridge app and click the Settings tab at the top.

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep4Text
data.value: Paste the copied device token into the Device token field. The token comes from the Wasla web panel.

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep5Text
data.value: Select the installed Windows receipt printer from the Printer name dropdown. If the printer is not visible, click Refresh. Example: POS-58

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep6Text
data.value: For real receipt printing, turn off Test mode. If "Do not send to printer, log only" is enabled, Print Bridge will only write logs and will not send output to the printer.

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep7Title
data.value: Step 7 — Save settings and test connection

data.name: PrintBridge.GuideStep7Text
data.value: Click Save settings. The app should validate the token and connect to the server. If successful, the device name should appear and the device should show online on the Devices page.

data.name: PrintBridge.ServerUrlInfoText
data.value: This address is provided by Wasla. You normally should not change it. The Print Bridge app shows the server URL under Advanced settings.

data.name: PrintBridge.TroubleshootingGuide1

data.name: Help.Yemeksepeti.Intro
data.value: Before you start, get your Yemeksepeti partner integration details: chain ID, vendor ID, client ID and client secret.

data.name: Help.Yemeksepeti.Step1
data.value: On the Platform Connections page, select "{0}" and choose Yemeksepeti as the platform.

data.name: Help.Yemeksepeti.Step2
data.value: Enter the chain ID in the Supplier Id field and the vendor ID in the Store Id field.

data.name: Help.Yemeksepeti.Step3
data.value: Enter the client ID in the API key field and the client secret in the API secret field, then save.

data.name: Help.PlatformManage.Body
data.value: The Platform Connections table shows each connection's status. Use the switch to turn a connection on or off, and edit it to update store and API details. Each platform can have only one connection.

data.name: Help.PlatformManage.Check
data.value: To test a connection, check the "{0}" column: it updates as new orders sync. If you see an error count or a temporary pause warning, check your API details.

data.name: Help.PrintBridge.Intro
data.value: Wasla Print Bridge is the Windows app that sends receipts to your printer. Install it on the computer the printer is connected to.

data.name: Help.PrintBridge.Step1
data.value: On the Windows computer your receipt printer is connected to, open the Print Bridge setup page and download the Windows application package (ZIP).

data.name: Help.PrintBridge.Step2
data.value: Extract the ZIP file to a folder.

data.name: Help.PrintBridge.Step3
data.value: Run Wasla.PrintBridge.exe once. If Windows asks for the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime, install it.

data.name: Help.PrintBridge.Step4
data.value: On the setup page, choose how to connect: "{0}" opens the app and connects it automatically (recommended), or connect manually by pasting a device token and the Wasla Web Panel URL into Print Bridge's Settings. Never share the device token.

data.name: Help.PrintBridge.Step5
data.value: In Print Bridge, open Settings, choose your receipt printer, click "Save printer", then "Print test receipt".

data.name: Help.PrintBridge.Step6
data.value: Once Wasla verifies the connection, get to know your device: its page shows the connection, and it's where you regenerate its token or remove it. See "{0}" below.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Intro
data.value: Each Print Bridge installation appears as a device under Print Bridge Devices. Open a device's details to rename it, check its connection, regenerate its token or remove it.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Name.Body
data.value: The name Wasla shows for one Print Bridge installation, next to the computer's name. Each computer that runs Print Bridge is a separate device.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Status.Body
data.value: "Connected" means Wasla heard from this installation within the last minute. Last seen shows when it last checked in; an older time usually means the app or the computer is off.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Token.Body
data.value: The device token lets this installation sign in to Wasla and receive print jobs. Wasla doesn't keep the token itself, so it can never be shown again after it was created.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Regenerate.New
data.value: Creates a new device token for this device.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Regenerate.OldStops
data.value: The old token stops working immediately, so this installation can't print until it has the new one.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Regenerate.EnterAgain
data.value: Enter the new token in the Print Bridge app's Settings, then save and test the connection.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Regenerate.ShownOnce
data.value: The new token is shown only once.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Remove.Access
data.value: Ends this device's access to Wasla; its token stops working.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Remove.Jobs
data.value: That installation no longer receives print jobs.

data.name: Help.PrintBridgeDevices.Remove.When
data.value: Use it only for an installation that is retired, lost or replaced.

data.name: Help.Printer.Body
data.value: In the Print Bridge app, open Settings, choose your receipt printer from the "Printer name" list and save.

data.name: Help.Printer.Template
data.value: The receipt's content and layout are set on the "{0}" page in Wasla.

data.name: Help.TestPrint.Body
data.value: After choosing the printer, select "Print test receipt" in the Print Bridge app. A test receipt should come out of the printer.

data.name: Help.TestPrint.Check
data.value: If nothing prints, check that the printer is on, has paper and is the right printer in Windows. The Print Bridge devices page shows the device's connection status and recent print jobs.

data.name: Help.LiveScreen.Body
data.value: The Live Screen is for following incoming orders in the kitchen and at the counter in real time. View orders as {0}, {1} or {2}, and get sound and browser notifications for new orders.

data.name: Help.Approve.Body
data.value: When a new order arrives, check it and select "{0}"; the approval is sent to the platform. If you can't fulfil the order, use "{1}".

data.name: Help.Prepare.Body
data.value: On an approved order, select "{0}" to show your team that preparation has started.

data.name: Help.Ready.Body
data.value: When the order is ready, select "{0}". This is the restaurant's last action on the order; the platform is notified.

data.name: Help.CourierPickup.Body
data.value: The platform's courier collects the order. When the courier picks it up, the platform reports it and Wasla moves the order to "{0}" automatically. You don't need to do anything in Wasla.

data.name: Help.Delivered.Body
data.value: Delivery is reported by the platform too. When the courier delivers the order, Wasla moves it to "{0}" automatically.

data.name: Help.DeliveredWindow.Title
data.value: How long delivered orders stay on the Live Screen

data.name: Help.DeliveredWindow.Body
data.value: Delivered orders stay on the Live Screen for {0} minutes and are then removed from that screen only. The orders are not deleted.

data.name: Help.OrderHistory.Body
data.value: All delivered and cancelled orders are on the "{0}" page. Filter by platform, status and date, or search by order code.

data.name: Help.Troubleshooting.NoOrders
data.value: Orders aren't arriving: check on Platform Connections that the connection is active and look at its last successful sync time.

data.name: Help.Troubleshooting.NoPrint
data.value: Receipts aren't printing: check that the Print Bridge device shows as connected and the right printer is selected in the app, then look at recent print jobs on the Print Bridge page.

data.name: Help.Troubleshooting.NoSound
data.value: The new-order sound doesn't play: check that sound is on for the Live Screen and that the browser allows audio.

data.name: Help.Troubleshooting.MissingPage
data.value: If you can't see a page or button, your role may not have permission for it; ask the restaurant owner for help.

data.name: Help.Troubleshooting.Support
data.value: If the problem continues, contact support. If you saw an error page, sharing its reference code helps find the problem faster.

data.name: Help.NeedsPermission
data.value: You don't have permission to open this page; ask the restaurant owner if you need it.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.Intro.Title
data.value: Order training on the Live Screen

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.Intro.Body
data.value: New orders appear here as cards and move forward as you work on them. Start a practice order to try the flow. It is marked {6} and only you can see it: it is not sent to Trendyol GO or Yemeksepeti, not printed, and not counted in your orders or reports.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.New.Body
data.value: The practice order marked {6} is waiting as a new order. Accept it with the {1} button on its card.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.Accepted.Body
data.value: The order is accepted. Press {2} when the kitchen starts on it.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.Preparing.Body
data.value: When the order is packed, press {3}. This is the restaurant's last step.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.Ready.Body
data.value: You don't need to press anything else. The platform's courier collects the order, and its status changes to {4} automatically.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.OnTheWay.Title
data.value: The order is on the way

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.OnTheWay.Body
data.value: The courier has the order. When it reaches the customer, the platform marks it {5} automatically.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Step.Delivered.Body
data.value: Completed real orders stay on the Live Screen for {0} minutes and then leave this screen. They are not deleted: you can still find them in Orders and order history. This practice order is not saved there.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Waiting
data.value: Still waiting? Courier updates come from Wasla's background service. If it is paused, the practice order stays safely at this step until the service runs again.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.CourierNote
data.value: Once the order is ready, the restaurant doesn't update it any more: the platform's courier reports collection and delivery automatically.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.HelpNote
data.value: How-to guides are always available in

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.Completed
data.value: Order training is complete, and guided setup is finished. How-to guides stay available in Help and Guides.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.PracticeFailed
data.value: The practice order couldn't be started. Please try again.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.NotYetDelivered
data.value: You can complete the training once the practice order has been delivered.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.RealOrders.TitleOne
data.value: A real order arrived while you were training

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.RealOrders.TitleMany
data.value: {0} real orders arrived while you were training

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.RealOrders.BodyOne
data.value: You can continue training. You can manage the order from your platform panel. Active orders will be shown on the Live Screen once training is complete.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Training.RealOrders.BodyMany
data.value: You can continue training. You can manage the orders from your platform panel. Active orders will be shown on the Live Screen once training is complete.

data.name: GuidedSetup.Panel.NotReadyYet
data.value: This step isn't finished yet. You can finish the setup or choose to set it up later.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.Title
data.value: Return the test tenant to first use

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.Intro
data.value: Only visible in local Development. Returns this tenant to the state it had right after provisioning, so you can test guided setup again from the first Start/Skip choice.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.Warning
data.value: This can't be undone. This tenant's orders, provider connections, Print Bridge devices and test configuration will be removed. Print jobs, synchronization state, notification settings, guided-setup progress and practice orders are reset too.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.Keeps
data.value: Kept: the tenant, its domain and slug, all users, passwords and roles, branches, and subscription and payment records. Nothing is revoked at the platforms; only Wasla's local configuration is removed.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.BrowserPermission
data.value: The browser's notification permission can't be reset by the app. When testing that scenario, reset it manually in Chrome's site settings.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.ConfirmLabel
data.value: To confirm, type this tenant's slug exactly:

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.SlugMismatch
data.value: The slug you typed doesn't match this tenant. Nothing was changed.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.Failed
data.value: The reset couldn't be completed and was rolled back. Nothing was changed.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.Succeeded
data.value: The test tenant is back at first use. If you need to, reset the browser's notification permission manually in Chrome's site settings.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.StopWorker
data.value: Before using the reset, stop Wasla.Worker, close the Print Bridge application and make sure no Print Bridge setup is currently in progress. Otherwise a sync cycle or setup that is still running could add data again after the reset, and the mock provider keeps order numbers in memory. Start the Worker again once the reset is done.

data.name: DevelopmentTools.Reset.Partial
data.value: The reset only partly finished: the Print Bridge devices were removed, but the rest was rolled back. Run the reset again to complete it.
